summary: Single-engine Socata TB21 (N25153) flying Durango (Animas Air Park) to Aspen for a holiday party flew into snowy instrument conditions and went down in dense forest at ~11,000 ft about 1.5 mi north of Silverton, ~1:35 p.m.; all four aboard killed (pilot Steve Osborne 59, his wife Jan Osborne 50, Tyler Black 24, Gena Rych 26). Search suspended Saturday in worsening weather; resumed Sunday; two victims recovered Sunday, the other two Tuesday; 30+ responders from nine agencies.
location: Dense forest ~1.5 mi north of Silverton, ~11,000 ft
responding_agency: San Juan County Search and Rescue; Silverton Fire & Rescue; San Juan County Fire & Rescue; K-9 unit (Dolores); Silverton Snowmobile Club; La Plata County Sheriff Office
